req.title: Task title trimmed of whitespace
req.statement: The system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from the title on POST /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-037 requires that POST /tasks/ trims leading and trailing whitespace from the task title before persisting it. The test suite covers: (1) a positive EP case where a title with surrounding whitespace is submitted and the stored title is the stripped version; (2) a positive EP case with only leading whitespace; (3) a positive EP case with only trailing whitespace; (4) a BVA boundary case where the title is a single non-whitespace character surrounded by spaces (minimum valid content after trim); (5) a NEG case where the title is all whitespace, which after trimming becomes an empty string and should be rejected (4xx) because min_length=1 is enforced; (6) a DT case combining whitespace padding with a description to ensure trimming is isolated to the title field. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with an in-memory SQLite DB to remain deterministic and idempotent.

tests.executable:
import os, sys
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_r037_pos1.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_title_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_trimmed():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "   Buy milk   ", "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Buy milk"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)

test_title_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_trimmed()
os.remove("./test_r037_pos1.db") if os.path.exists("./test_r037_pos1.db") else None
